intervals.label: conceptual design (proposed experiment)
intervals.note: Start is the arXiv submission of the conceptual design (12 Jan 2023). Later talks (IOP April 2026, IDM June 2026) say the detector 'is planned to be fully electroformed underground at the Boulby Underground Laboratory' and describe a 30 cm version in preparation; no approval or construction start is stated.
intervals.quote: We present the conceptual design and the physics potential of DarkSPHERE, a proposed 3 m in diameter spherical proportional counter electroformed underground at the Boulby Underground Laboratory.

placements.note: Boulby Underground Laboratory (the design places it in the Large Experimental Cavern: 'The ∅3 m electroformed-copper sphere is surrounded by a 2.5 m water shield and will be housed in the Large Experimental Cavern (LEC) at the Boulby Underground Laboratory'); the Atlas has one Boulby site record.
placements.quote: We present the conceptual design and the physics potential of DarkSPHERE, a proposed 3 m in diameter spherical proportional counter electroformed underground at the Boulby Underground Laboratory.

diameter.note: Conceptual-design (2023) size. Later talks describe a 30 cm version in preparation, and a University of Liverpool studentship page describes a 1.4 m counter; no source read states the final size.
diameter.quote: a proposed 3 m in diameter spherical proportional counter

summary.plain: A hollow copper sphere, filled with a light gas and read out by a central sensor, that detects the tiny ionization produced when light dark matter bumps a gas atom.
summary.technical: Proposed 3 m diameter electroformed-copper spherical proportional counter with a 60-anode ACHINOS sensor, He-isobutane gas, inside a 2.5 m water shield in the Large Experimental Cavern at Boulby.

technology.value: Electroformed-copper spherical proportional counter filled with a helium-isobutane gas mixture
